title: Moscord
description: Moscord is a digital marketplace that connects buyers and sellers in the maritime industry, offering a platform for various suppliers to aggregate and present their products. The company aims to enhance business operations for its clients by providing innovative solutions in procurement, logistics, and eCommerce. Targeting maritime and oil & gas sectors, Moscord serves a global clientele through its extensive network of ports and offices across multiple countries. With a focus on improving user experience and operational efficiency, Moscord leverages advanced technology and industry expertise to facilitate seamless transactions.
